reviewKind: Independent read-only source/custody review of a parent-executed native replay; no reviewer DB/cloud run.
assessment: New harness differs from the previously reviewed exact source only in header/scope and the fixed CI wheel/native-module digests. Exact four-method inventory and no-skip/no-expected-failure checks are unchanged.

Committed _routine_attachments checks direct pg_trigger routine attachments without an enabled filter and pg_depend references to truss routines. Relation-owned trigger/default/constraint/rewrite dependencies are accepted only within recursively private native homes; other attachments refuse. Existing verification invokes this at activation and guarded use.

Original native test installs a disabled external trigger on an outsider-owned table using the internal runtime_capture_feed_configuration routine, observes activation refusal with the dedicated diagnostic, then drops the carrier before the ordinary positive workflow. This establishes that finite refusal, not execution of an exploit or arbitrary effect closure.

CI cohort is explicitly added alongside the unchanged older ABI2 cohort. Actual imported native-module digest selects exactly one cohort; retained consumer evidence and original UMF child are checked. Extra aggregate APIs in the wheel do not enroll a new ABI or query profile.
All 158 original case definitions match current HEAD; all 30 Truss cases remain in the inventory. No acceptance case is promoted by this packet.
scopeLimits: Finite local macOS ARM PostgreSQL18.6 read-only activated profile; trusted installer executor, host quiescence through activation commit and quiescent administrative DDL during use remain premises.

Does not qualify arbitrary callable/effect/writer closure, hostile administrators, native connection fencing, concurrent migration, every projection/graph/aggregate/raw backend path or all required Truss cases.
Exact selected CI wheel bytes are qualified for the retained ABI2 replay only; no published-release correspondence, reproducible-build theorem or aggregate API qualification.

Provenance covers selected tracked source inputs, loaded Truss modules, wheel Python/native files, child bytes and PostgreSQL binary; Python/Bun executables and every transitive runtime dependency are not exhaustively binary-pinned.
Cleanup was executed by the original harness and retained in its passing receipt; reviewer also checked the recorded data directory remains absent. No new process or DB was launched by the reviewer.
wordingPrecision: Packet README should describe selected source/module/child/PostgreSQL binary inventories rather than an unbounded complete executable inventory.
